label: Week 33, 2026
recap:
This was a quiet week for US AI policy and litigation, with only one bill movement and one case update recorded. Activity was limited to a single jurisdiction, North Carolina, and a single federal document, with the Commodity Futures Trading Commission appearing as the sole agency mentioned. The bill movement reflects a status change on that record, not passage of any law.

On themes, the one bill that could be categorized fell under Government use, covering how agencies buy, deploy, and account for AI, including inventories and procurement rules. No other themes appeared in the data this week. Overall, the week showed a small, narrow set of developments rather than any broad or coordinated push across states or the federal government.

federal.title: Innovation Advisory Committee
federal.detail: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) announces that on August 20, 2026, from 1:00 p.m. to 4:00 p.m. Eastern Daylight Time, the Innovation Advisory Committee (IAC or Committee) will hold an in- person meeting for IAC members, with options for the public to attend virtually. At this meeting, the IAC will discuss topics including crypto assets, artificial intelligence, and prediction markets, along with recent CFTC activity in these markets.
